info.name: OpenBook API — functional and security regression
info.description: Run all folders in order against a disposable OpenBook test instance. Generates two unique accounts and validates real authentication, ownership, uploads, reading lists, social privacy and SSRF defenses. See docs/testing.md for setup and cleanup limitations. Requests use explicit cookies with the cookie jar disabled.

03 Books, tags and ownership
item.description: Creates one book per account and checks that the second account cannot read or change the owner book.

04 Private EPUB uploads
item.description: Requires the repository root as Postman working directory. Upload checks use small, committed local fixtures.

item.name: Upload a valid private EPUB and cover

exec: pm.test("Cover URL does not expose server paths", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().coverUrl).to.match(/^\/uploads\/books\/covers\/[a-f0-9-]+\.png$/));
